name: Mind Meld
hook: One clue. One dial. How in sync is your team?
how: Each round one player secretly sees a target on a dial between two opposites, like cold and hot, and gives a short clue. The team turns the dial together and locks in: the closer to the target, the more team points.
controls: Drag the dial (or arrow keys), Lock in with the button or Enter; the clue-giver types a clue
uses: The target is sealed so only the clue-giver can read it (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser deals the cards, runs the timers and scores each round; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone turns one shared dial and sees it move.
Bots give clues and turn the dial until enough people join.
The team's best total in one game.
ideas: Add a card pack about food
Let the other team guess left or right for a bonus point
Make a bullseye shower the screen with confetti
